claims.locator: 'Availability of Department of the Navy Records and Publication of Department of the Navy Documents Affecting the Public', effective 9 June 1994
claims.sourceText: Federal Register Doc 94-13966, 'Availability of Department of the Navy Records and Publication of Department of the Navy Documents Affecting the Public', effective 9 June 1994, https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/1994/06/09/94-13966/availability-of-department-of-the-navy-records-and-publication-of-department-of-the-navy-documents
claims.text: The Department of the Navy final rule published on 9 June 1994, FR Doc 94-13966, amended 32 CFR 701.5(e)(2)(iii)(B) by removing 'Commander, Naval Investigative Service Command' and adding in its place 'Director, Naval Criminal Investigative Service'.
